newsitem.title: SPAIN: Clinton declines comment on U.S. Senate probe.
newsitem.headline: Clinton declines comment on U.S. Senate probe.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton on Tuesday declined comment on the start of a U.S. Senate probe into possible illegal campaign fundraising practices, saying he was too busy working at the NATO summit to follow its developments.

Following remarks to U.S. Embassy staff in Madrid after the first day of a NATO meeting in which leaders invited Poland, Hungary and the Czech Republic to join the alliance, Clinton was asked for his thoughts on the investigation by the Senate Governmental Affairs Committee.

"I have no comment," Clinton said in trying to brush aside the question. "I don't even know" the details of the first day of hearings that included accusations that Chinese officials had tried to illegally send money into Democratic Party coffers for last year's elections.
"I can't comment on it," Clinton said. "I've been working here."
